sn22.151:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa
sn22.151:1.3: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassatīti || || 4
sn22.151:1.5: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa || la || ||
sn22.151:1.6: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa
sn22.151:1.7: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupassati || || 10
sn22.151:1.9: rūpaṃ niccam vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.151:1.11: vipariṇāmadhammam api me tam anupādāya Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti samanupasseyyā ti || ||
sn22.151:1.16: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
